title: What will Donald Trump say during Midterm Rally in Syracuse, New York originally scheduled for October 9, 2026? Trump Account
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Trump Account as part of Midterm Rally in Syracuse, New York originally scheduled for October 9, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Midterm Rally in Syracuse, New York originally scheduled for October 9, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Midterm Rally in Syracuse, New York originally scheduled for October 9, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: The Syracuse rally is confirmed for Oct 9, 2026 at the Oncenter, with remarks at 7 PM and an endorsement of Bruce Blakeman. Trump Accounts are a self-branded program that launched in 2026, and Trump sometimes includes them when he lists accomplishments. But his rally speeches lean heavily on immigration, tariffs, opponents and local politics, so the phrase is far from guaranteed. I couldn't verify how often he has used it at recent rallies, so this estimate rests on judgment about his speaking habits.
blind.falsifier: Trump saying 'Trump Accounts' while listing economic or family-related accomplishments during his Syracuse remarks, or evidence that he has been using it routinely at recent fall 2026 rallies.

final.reasoning: The market's 38.5% midpoint is only slightly above my 34% estimate. It may reflect knowledge of recent rally usage that I couldn't check, so I move toward it a little. With a 2–3 point gap and weak evidence, there's no edge worth taking.
